role: separate holdout; never canonical corpus or canonical aggregation
frozen_before: any implementation grammar patch or holdout parse/compile/grade
selection_rule: Select the first nonempty tracked regular lowercase .cl population, with OSI root license, from the ordered official project list KhronosGroup/OpenCL-CTS then intel/compute-samples. Use the whole pinned repository population. No parse, compiler, coverage, content or duplicate filter. Never change membership in response to results.

candidates.disposition: ineligible: no standalone .cl population; no parse or compile attempted
selected by metadata-only rule before measurement

population: Every tracked regular lowercase .cl, including fragments and duplicate blobs; symlinks and gitlinks counted separately; submodule contents uncovered. Retain every file regardless of parse or compiler result.
interpretation: Git-tree metadata is a prospective count, not a filesystem manifest or parser result. Confirm raw Git identities and capture exact before/after tracked-set receipts in the holdout checkout.
